_src: United commission structure wef 01-08-2026 (Sub-Annexure 1 PCV). Bands by Passenger-Carrying-Capacity (seats). 4W PCV >6 pax vs Taxi (<=6 pax) split on seating; buses (educational/staff/school) 62.5%; 2W-PCV 10%; 3W handled by the 3W grid.

pcv4w._note: >6 passengers. Package and SATP identical. PCC = seating capacity.

bands._note: PCC>30 non-EV: OD 10% / TP 0% -> 10% headline (OD leg)

taxi._note: <=6 passengers. Package vs SATP differ on the 'other states' rate.
